name: deliverable-review-quality-gate
description: Professional Services Cowork plugin: review a draft deliverable before client issue. Retrieves the deliverable, support pack and QRM gate criteria; maps assertions to evidence with deterministic assertion_map; determines gate compliance with deterministic gate_check; ranks release blockers, must-fix items and advisories with deterministic severity_rank; drafts a partner review packet. Govern is explicit because review status is a firm-risk determination. Draft-first; no sign-off, client-issue approval, reliance authorization or substitution for reviewing-partner judgement.
